units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|278|0
units.english: Finally scraped together enough money for a down payment on a starship. The interest on the mortgage is exorbitant.
units.raw: log "Finally scraped together enough money for a down payment on a starship. The interest on the mortgage is exorbitant."

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|279|0
units.english: Hundreds of years ago, the independent territories in different parts of human space agreed to join together into a single democratic government, with Earth as its capital. The rise of the Republic ushered in a long period of peace and prosperity in human history.
units.raw: log "Factions" "Republic" `Hundreds of years ago, the independent territories in different parts of human space agreed to join together into a single democratic government, with Earth as its capital. The rise of the Republic ushered in a long period of peace and prosperity in human history.`

units.id: conversation:hai intro|Representation in the Republic Parliament is based on population. That means that some individual "Paradise Worlds" have more representatives than entire regions of space like the Dirt Belt that are more sparsely settled.|280|0

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|281|0
units.english: The Syndicate is a megacorporation, the largest employer in human space. People who cannot find steady work elsewhere flock to the Syndicate factory worlds, where they are almost guaranteed to find a job. Although the Syndicate is technically part of the Republic, Syndicate worlds are governed directly by the corporation.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|The Syndicate is a central part of the Republic's economy, but they are also well known for selling shoddy products and for doing damage to the environment on the worlds they control. Their treatment of workers is questionable, and their opposition to organized labor is legendary. Some Syndicate factory towns have even been accused of human rights abuses.|282|0

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|283|0
units.english: In poorer and more remote star systems, where the Navy seldom patrols, pirate attacks on merchant ships are frequent. Pirates are also known to attack large, unguarded convoys of freighters even in more populated areas. Most pirate fleets come from lawless worlds on the outskirts of human space.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|284|0
units.english: The Hai are a species of giant, intelligent rodents, who live to the north of human space. They allow any humans who discover their territory to live alongside them, and to trade with them and purchase their technology.
units.raw: log "Factions" "Hai" `The Hai are a species of giant, intelligent rodents, who live to the north of human space. They allow any humans who discover their territory to live alongside them, and to trade with them and purchase their technology.`

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|285|0
units.english: The "Unfettered" are a faction within the Hai species who are not as peaceful as the rest, and are normally not friendly toward humans. They claim that long ago the Drak altered the Hai to make them docile and peaceful, and that the Unfettered are descendants of those Hai who avoided undergoing that alteration. They are seeking jump drives so that they can escape the "prison" they are now stuck in: a few deteriorating worlds on the far northern edge of Hai space.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|log|286|0
units.english: A long extinct dragon-like species called the "Sheragi" used to live in human space, back when much of what is now human territory was occupied by the Hai.

units.id: conversation:hai intro|Going to the North Pole already makes you feel as if you're on another world; even within the berth for your ferry, you can see more Hai than there are in your entire hometown.
